title: Custom eggless cakes ready for pickup before your Marsden Park shift
summary:
Forgot the cake for tonight's party and still have an early shift in Marsden Park? Riverstone opens at 6am on weekdays — pick your order up before work, not after.

Every cake here is 100% eggless. Not an option, not a substitute — the only way we bake. Six sizes, 15 flavours including Rasmalai and Ferrero Rocher, any design from a photo reference.

48 hours minimum notice. That's what fresh baking actually takes. Free parking at Riverstone Shopping Centre, five minutes from Schofields and ten from Box Hill.

Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725.
